Section Roster Management

PowerSchool Professional Learning

https://atgp.link/PSPLroster

Part 1 — How to Find Your Course / Section

If you are an Instructor on the section…
  1. 1

    Click the Professional Learning menu and click the Instruct button. On the Instruct Dashboard you will see three tabs:

    • a
      Open — sections currently under way.
    • b
      Future — sections with a begin date in the future.
    • c
      Closed — sections with an end date in the past.
  2. 2

    Click the desired tab and find your section. Use the Select a Column drop box to search by course number, course title, section number, or section title. Click the section title to open the section details page.

If you created the course / section…
  1. 1

    Click the Professional Learning menu and then click the Build button.

  2. 2

    On the Build Courses and Sections page, your courses/sections are listed with the most recent at the top in date order.

  3. 3

    To find a specific course/section, click the Advanced Filters link on the right side of the page and search by course number, course title, section number, or section title. Click the section title to open the section details page.

If you are an Office Administrator or Final Approver…
  1. 1

    Click the Professional Learning menu, then click the Manage button and select Manage Sections.

  2. 2

    On the Manage Sections page, click the Advanced Filters link and search by course number, course title, section number, or section title. Click the section title to open the section details page.

Part 2 — Managing the Roster

ROSTER

Roster Actions — Section Details Page

  1. 1

    From the Section Details page, click the Roster tab to open the Section Roster screen.

  2. 2

    Adding Participants Manually: On the Section Roster screen, click the drop box on the Bulk Actions button and choose Search for Learners.

  3. 3

    On the Search for Users screen, type the participant’s name in the search box and click the Update link. When the participant appears, click the check box next to their name and then click the Add User button.

  4. 4

    Getting a Registration Link: Click the Ellipses link in the upper right corner and choose Copy Registration Link. The Ellipses menu also lets you cancel, copy, delete, or archive the section — options available only under certain circumstances and to users with the correct administrative permissions.

  5. 5

    Printing Sign-In Sheets: Click the Print Forms button to print name tags, sign-in sheets, and table tents, or to export the section roster.

  6. 6

    Marking Attendance: Click the Attendance tab. For each participant, click the drop arrow and choose Attended, Absent, or Not Recorded. You can also click Edit All at the top of the attendance column to set the entire column at once.

    Important: If Class Times have not been set, you will not be able to mark attendance.
  7. 7

    Locking and Unlocking Roster Entries: Click the lock symbol in the Locked/Unlocked column to lock or unlock individual entries. Entries must be unlocked to change Registration Status or Credit Amount. To unlock the entire column at once, click Edit All at the top of the column and choose Unlock all records.

  8. 8

    Awarding Different Credit Amounts: If some participants will not earn the full amount of clock hours, click the Edit All link at the top of the Credits column and choose Update all manually. On the Manage Credit screen, you can enter varying amounts of clock hours for each participant.

    Note: If you cannot change participant hours on this screen, you will need to unlock the roster entries first (see step 7 above).
  9. 9

    Awarding Credit: Click the drop box for each participant in the Registration column and change their status from Registered to Complete-Pending Survey. To update the entire column at once, click the Edit All link at the top of the Registration Status column and choose Update all manually.
